# Sick Leave

> SAMPLE CONTENT for development and evals. Not a real company policy.

## Sick days

Employees receive 10 sick days each calendar year. Sick days are separate from vacation days and do not carry over.

## Reporting an absence

Notify your manager before your scheduled start time. For absences longer than three consecutive days, provide a doctor's note.
